policy: Mercury Redux uses only canonical Pokémon types. Source-library custom types are preserved only as provenance; playable Mercury moves are retyped to canonical types.

resolutions.name: Drum Beat
resolutions.rationale: Canonical sound-based attacks are normally Normal-type.

resolutions.name: Beat Drop
resolutions.rationale: Canonical sound-based attacks are normally Normal-type.

resolutions.name: Strident Spark
resolutions.rationale: Spark/electric identity retained; obsolete bonus versus Sound-type targets is removed.

resolutions.name: Rhythmic Combo
resolutions.rationale: Physical rhythmic combo fits Fighting once Sound is removed.

resolutions.name: Instant Whistle
resolutions.rationale: Whistle/redirection move uses canonical Normal typing.

resolutions.name: Discordant Shriek
resolutions.rationale: Chilling supernatural shriek fits Ghost.

resolutions.name: Heart Beat
resolutions.rationale: Heartbeat/sound identity maps cleanly to Normal.

resolutions.name: Audio Break
resolutions.rationale: Physical sound-barrier punch fits Fighting.

resolutions.name: Unleashed Power
resolutions.rationale: Base type becomes Normal; its dynamic-type mechanic remains separately deferred.

resolutions.name: Blinding Speed
resolutions.rationale: Base type becomes Normal; dynamic user-type behavior remains separately deferred.

resolutions.name: Domain Shift
resolutions.rationale: Field/domain manipulation fits Psychic.

resolutions.name: Titan's Wrath
resolutions.rationale: Base type becomes Normal; dynamic user-type/stat behavior remains separately deferred.

resolutions.name: Queso Blast
resolutions.rationale: Molten-cheese projectile fits Fire.

resolutions.name: Hard Drive Crash
resolutions.rationale: Digital/electronic attack fits Electric.

resolutions.name: Virus Inject
resolutions.rationale: Virus/toxin identity fits Poison.

resolutions.name: Chthonic Malady
resolutions.rationale: Chthonic/curse identity fits Ghost.

resolutions.name: Patterning
resolutions.rationale: Shadow-source status move maps to Dark.

resolutions.name: Atomic Punch
resolutions.rationale: Radiation/toxicity identity maps to Poison.

resolutions.name: Nuclear Waste
resolutions.rationale: Toxic waste maps directly to Poison.

resolutions.name: Gamma Ray
resolutions.rationale: Radiation identity maps to Poison; Nuclear-specific type chart is removed.

resolutions.name: Radioacid
resolutions.rationale: Radioactive acid maps directly to Poison.

resolutions.name: Half-life
resolutions.rationale: Radiation identity maps to Poison.

resolutions.name: Fission Burst
resolutions.rationale: Nuclear/radiation identity maps to Poison while keeping explosion mechanics.

resolutions.name: Nuclear Slash
resolutions.rationale: Radiation identity maps to Poison.

resolutions.name: Expunge
resolutions.rationale: Radiation identity maps to Poison; bonus versus Nuclear targets is removed.

resolutions.name: Fallout
resolutions.rationale: Base type becomes Poison; Fallout field mechanics remain separately deferred.

resolutions.name: Proton Beam
resolutions.rationale: Radiation identity maps to Poison.

resolutions.name: Quantum Leap
resolutions.rationale: Radiation identity maps to Poison; two-turn behavior remains separately audited.

resolutions.name: Nuclear Wind
resolutions.rationale: Base type becomes Poison; Fallout weather rider remains separately deferred.

resolutions.name: Crystal Rush
resolutions.rationale: Crystal/mineral identity maps directly to Rock.

resolutions.name: An Attack
resolutions.rationale: Generic untyped/glitch attack becomes Normal.

resolutions.name: Meme
resolutions.rationale: Generic glitch-style attack becomes Normal while retaining its move effect.
